content: {"episode_id": "ep-05032", "cpt": "93229", "denial_carc": "CO-197", "necessity_paragraph": "The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks accompanied by palpitations and episodic lightheadedness, raising concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia as the potential embolic source. To correlate these neurological symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered to capture intermittent events over an extended period and identify paroxysmal arrhythmias missed during standard office evaluations, addressing diagnoses I49.9 and G45.9."}
